definitions.explanation: A specific location or part of something. Often used as a counter for places or points.

examples.japanese: ⟦{文章|ぶんしょう}→文章：02957_bunshou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{間違|まちが}い→間違い：03733_machigai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧3{箇所|かしょ}⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are three mistakes in the text.
examples.notes: [Note: 箇所 used as a counter]

examples.japanese: ⟦{工事中|こうじちゅう}→工事中：09625_koujichuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{箇所|かしょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please be careful of construction areas.

examples.japanese: ⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧⟦な→な：09497_na⟧{箇所|かしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}→確認：00158_kakunin⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。

notes:
WRITING: Also written as {ヵ所|かしょ}, {カ所|かしょ}, or {か所|かしょ}. All are acceptable.

AS A COUNTER:
・1{箇所|かしょ} (one place)
・{数|すう}{箇所|かしょ} (several places)
・{何|なん}{箇所|かしょ} (how many places?)

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{問題|もんだい}の{箇所|かしょ} (problematic area)
・{該当|がいとう}{箇所|かしょ} (relevant section)
・{修正|しゅうせい}{箇所|かしょ} (corrected parts)
・{変更|へんこう}{箇所|かしょ} (changed parts)

SIMILAR COUNTERS:
・〜{点|てん} (counter for points/items)
・〜{所|しょ} (counter for places - more formal)
・〜{つ} (general counter)
